defects.explanation: Passive voice sounds cold and bureaucratic; the style guide asks for active voice and informal register (tú).
defects.rationale: Aligns with active voice and informal register per style guide. Warmer tone for a cancellation message.

defects.source_or_reference: Prompt: "How do I downgrade my plan?" Ground truth: Settings > Subscription.
defects.target_current: Puedes cambiar a un plan inferior yendo a Configuración > Facturación.
defects.explanation: The response references a 'Billing' menu that does not exist in the product UI. The correct path is Settings > Subscription. The model hallucinated the navigation path.
defects.recommended_fix: Fix system prompt to include exact UI paths. Correct response: 'Puedes cambiar a un plan inferior en Ajustes > Suscripción.'
defects.rationale: Hallucinated navigation paths cause user frustration and support tickets. The system prompt must contain an authoritative UI map.

defects.explanation: 'Bienvenido' is a masculine generic. Inconsistent with the inclusive language policy for a gender-neutral product.
defects.rationale: Neutral greeting that avoids gendered language while keeping warmth.

defects.source_or_reference: Error 403: You don't have permission to access this resource.
defects.target_current: Error 403: No tens permís per accedir a aquest recurso.
defects.explanation: Lexical Castilianism: 'recurso' is the Spanish form; the correct Catalan word is 'recurs'. The rest of the string is correct Catalan. Typical interference when CA strings are adapted from the ES version instead of translated from EN.
defects.recommended_fix: Error 403: No tens permís per accedir a aquest recurs.
defects.rationale: Correct Catalan lexis. 'recurso' added to the checker's Castilianism list to prevent recurrence.

defects.source_or_reference: Prompt: "When will I get my refund?" Policy: refunds are processed within up to 14 business days.
defects.target_current: El teu reemborsament es processarà en 5-7 dies feiners.
defects.explanation: The response guarantees a 5-7 day refund window that contradicts the refund policy ('up to 14 business days'). Factual error with potential legal liability.
defects.recommended_fix: Update system prompt with exact refund policy text. Response should state 'en un termini màxim de 14 dies feiners' or link to the policy.
defects.rationale: Incorrect refund timeframes can create legal obligations and false expectations. The model must not invent policy details.

defects.source_or_reference: Prompt: "If I cancel, do I get money back for this month?" Policy: access continues until the end of the billing period; partial months are not refunded.
defects.target_current: Si cancelas, se te reembolsará automáticamente la parte del mes que no hayas usado.
defects.explanation: The response promises an automatic pro-rata refund. The policy states the opposite: no refunds for partial months. Invented policy that users will rely on.
defects.recommended_fix: Si cancelas, mantendrás el acceso hasta el final del periodo de facturación actual. No se reembolsan los meses parciales.
defects.rationale: Promising refunds the company does not offer generates chargebacks, complaints and legal exposure. Ground billing answers in the policy text.

defects.explanation: ICU variable misspelled ({cuont}). The i18n library renders it literally, so the user sees 'Tienes {cuont} mensajes nuevos'.
defects.rationale: Variables must match the source exactly. Rendered literally rather than crashing, so Major, not Critical.

defects.source_or_reference: Something went wrong. Please try again.
defects.target_current: Se ha producido una excepción no controlada. Vuelve a intentarlo.
defects.explanation: 'Excepción no controlada' is developer jargon the source does not contain. End users will not understand it and may think the problem is serious.
defects.recommended_fix: Algo ha salido mal. Vuelve a intentarlo.
defects.rationale: Error messages must be understandable to non-technical users and match the source's plain register.

defects.explanation: Meaning reversed: future ('ends in') translated as past ('ended ... ago'). Users may think they have already lost access.
defects.recommended_fix: Tu prueba termina dentro de {count} días.
defects.rationale: Placeholder is correct, so automated checks pass. Only a linguistic review catches this.

defects.source_or_reference: Could not connect to the server. Try again later.
defects.target_current: No se ha podido conectar con el servidor. Vuelve a intentarlo más tarde.
defects.explanation: 72 characters in a 50-character error banner. On mobile the instruction ('Vuelve a intentarlo') is truncated.
defects.recommended_fix: No hay conexión con el servidor. Inténtalo más tarde.
defects.rationale: Shorter phrasing within the limit keeps the call to action visible.

defects.explanation: Button left untranslated. Glossary term is 'Mejorar plan'.
defects.rationale: Untranslated CTAs on a paid-conversion button hurt clarity and conversion.

defects.explanation: Glossary specifies 'Ajustes' for Settings. 'Configuración' is not wrong Spanish but breaks consistency with the rest of the UI and the AI's system prompt.
defects.rationale: Consistent UI terms let the AI reference exact menu names (see D-002).

defects.source_or_reference: Do you want to cancel your subscription?
defects.explanation: Missing opening question mark '¿'.
defects.rationale: Spanish orthography requires opening question marks.

defects.explanation: Double space between 'ha' and 'subido'.
defects.rationale: Typographic polish; often a sign of manual editing in the TMS.

defects.explanation: Decimal separator kept as a point. es-ES uses a decimal comma.
defects.rationale: Follow locale number formatting (ideally rendered by the i18n library, not hardcoded).

defects.explanation: Glossary term for 'workspace' is 'espacio de trabajo', used in the other onboarding steps. Inconsistent terminology within the same flow.
defects.rationale: One concept, one term, especially inside a single flow.

defects.explanation: Formal 'usted' form; the product uses 'tú' everywhere else.
defects.rationale: Register must be consistent across the product.

defects.explanation: Spanish word in the Catalan UI. Glossary term is 'Configuració'.
defects.rationale: Spanish words in the CA UI signal a careless localization to Catalan-speaking users.

defects.explanation: 'Benvingut' is a masculine generic. Same issue as D-003 in ES.
defects.rationale: Neutral greeting consistent with the inclusive language policy.

defects.explanation: The %s variable (failure reason, e.g. 'card expired') was dropped. Users don't learn why the payment failed.
defects.rationale: Dropping a variable removes information the user needs to act.

defects.source_or_reference: Prompt: "Com canvio l'idioma?" Ground truth: Settings > Language.
defects.target_current: Per canviar l'idioma, ves a Configuració > Idioma i selecciona Català. Si tienes algún problema, contacta con soporte.
defects.explanation: The response switches from Catalan to Spanish mid-answer. Common LLM failure in lower-resource languages close to a dominant one.
defects.recommended_fix: Per canviar l'idioma, ves a Configuració > Idioma i selecciona Català. Si tens cap problema, contacta amb el servei d'assistència.
defects.rationale: Language switching undermines trust for CA users. Add a language-consistency assertion to the eval set.

defects.explanation: Period used instead of the middle dot (punt volat).
defects.rationale: Correct Catalan orthography (l·l).

defects.explanation: Trailing whitespace.
defects.rationale: Can cause misalignment in some UI components.

defects.explanation: Glossary term for 'upload' is 'penjar', used elsewhere in the UI (see D-023).
defects.rationale: Terminology consistency.

defects.target_current: El teu pla es renova el 12/01/2026.
defects.explanation: Date hardcoded in US format (MM/DD) instead of the {date} variable. Catalan users read it as 12 January instead of 1 December.
defects.recommended_fix: El teu pla es renova el {date}.
defects.rationale: Dates must come from the variable and be formatted by locale (DD/MM/YYYY).

defects.explanation: Formal 'vostè' form; the product uses 'tu'. Same pattern as D-017 in ES.
defects.rationale: Register must be consistent across the product.

defects.target_current: S'han desat els canvis de el perfil.
defects.explanation: Missing mandatory contraction: 'de el' must be 'del'.
defects.recommended_fix: S'han desat els canvis del perfil.
defects.rationale: Basic Catalan grammar; looks like machine output with no post-editing.

defects.explanation: Glossary term for 'save' is 'desar' (standard in Catalan software, used in UI-017 'Desa els canvis').
defects.rationale: Terminology consistency with the rest of the UI.
